name: spike-c-adapter-server
description: Spike C minimal AtherNull-compatibility adapter for OpenHands' full frontend shell. Standalone Node/Express server, own deps, not in the pnpm workspace. Implements exactly the 4 REST endpoints spike-a-standalone-shell/upstream's mocks stand in for, each backed by a real read-only GET call to apps/api using one server-side Better Auth session cookie - never sent to the browser.
